changes.issue: A rejected initial state-load promise remains cached after its file is repaired.
changes.fix: Clear only failed load promises, retaining successful cached state and propagating read errors.
changes.acceptance: Invalid JSON and a directory at the file path each reject read/select/update, then recover in the same store after repair. Ten queued increments preserve count 40 to 50 and the unrelated keep field in each case. Corrupt input is not silently reset.

changes.issue: Failed atomic file renames leave temporary state files behind.
changes.fix: Attempt temporary-file cleanup after write/rename errors without replacing the original error.
changes.acceptance: Three real filesystem rename failures leave no temporary files and preserve cached count zero. A later valid write persists count one.

changes.issue: An explicit Telegram rate limit can prevent permission messages or their buttons from being delivered.
changes.fix: Reuse the existing bounded 429 retry helper for preferred/fallback text and keyboard activation.
changes.acceptance: Preferred and fallback text recover from one 429, and buttons recover after persistence. Exhaustion makes four total attempts. Ambiguous sends make one attempt. The isolated real host also recovers from injected 429 responses for text and buttons without duplicate permission messages.
